messages.text: Hi! I'd be happy to look into order #···· for you. Could you share the email address used on that order?
I bought two globes for my grand kids and when I opened the boxes a very bad smell emanated from the boxes.
That sounds unpleasant, I'm sorry. I can help get this to our team to make it right. Could you confirm the email address used on order #···· so I can pull it up?
Thanks, but for privacy I just need the email address that was used when placing order #···· (not the shipping address) so I can look it up.

Thanks, I found it — order #····, two Globe 4 Kids 10" French Language Illuminated Globes, delivered via Canpar (tracking: Canpar #····). Since this involves a damaged/defective item and it's been 36 days since delivery, I can't process a replacement myself — I'll hand this straight to our team.
Handed to the team · Damaged/defective item - bad odor from boxes

I've sent this directly to our team with your order details and the issue you described. They'll follow up by email at (email hidden), usually within one business day. Is there anything else I can help with in the meantime?

I know the 30 day has passed, but hopefully I can get a refund. They are Xmas gifts for my grandkids and I just decided I'd open the boxes to make sure nothing is missing. The smell is so bad, I had to put the boxes outside.

That extra context is really helpful, and I've made sure the owner has it — that you only opened them now to check before gifting, and the smell was bad enough you had to move the boxes outside. They'll take that into account when they reply by email. Is there anything else I can help with while you wait to hear back?
thank you for your help, I'll wait for the email.
You're welcome, Suzie — I hope your grandkids love exploring the world with those globes once this gets sorted. Have a good rest of your day!

Just wanted to add that I found the same Globes at a much lower price $55.95 https://www.shopperplus.ca/p-489044-ran-12534-globe-4-kids-1025cm-diameter-illuminated-globe-with-augmented-reality-english#sku580183
